findings.title: Work-package validation commands are not executable evidence-producing commands
evidence: MP-01 validationCommand and evidenceRecordBinding.command are exactly pwsh -NoProfile -File '.\tests\iac\Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1', but Invoke-DeploymentPreflight.ps1 declares BicepParamFile mandatory for its default BicepParam parameter set and ParameterObjectFile mandatory for its alternative set; the recorded command supplies neither.
MP-01 declares capability-and-quota-validation.json as evidenceOutput, yet its command contains no output path, OutputJson capture, serialization or evidence-writer step.

MP-02 through MP-08 similarly declare evidenceOutput paths while their recorded pwsh, npm or node commands only invoke validation; none explicitly creates, hashes and persists the declared evidence record.
findings.impact: Phase 5 cannot execute the plan as written or prove that the declared immutable validation evidence was produced by the recorded command, so a package can appear complete without reproducible evidence.
findings.remediation: In a new append-only candidate, provide executable parameterised commands, including an exact -BicepParamFile or -ParameterObjectFile for MP-01, and add explicit fail-closed evidence capture that writes each declared evidenceOutput with the command result and hashes.

findings.title: Candidate evidence is circular, chronologically invalid and does not bind the R2 content set
evidence: The R2 manifest generatedAt is 2026-08-06T11:14:30.586+02:00, while all three evidence records state generatedAt 2026-08-06T11:30:00.000+02:00; the manifest therefore claims generation before the evidence bytes it hashes existed.

stratton-cc-002-r2-hash-generation-evidence.json records a hash command whose six inputs include stratton-cc-002-r2-hash-generation-evidence.json itself, making reproduction of its final raw-byte hash circular.

Each concrete evidence record declares toolRuntimeVersions, timestamp, accountableOwner and disposition as required envelope fields, but none contains those concrete properties; generatedAt is not the required timestamp property.

All three evidence records bind subjectPath/subjectSha256 to the original manifest 07d9c07ecdf78285dab13f8e83972fc4268aad7c7cde546b2cea9e76782c5154 rather than the R2 content set represented by 1b61e2c30f0db7b3960aece1c5c28bc0462789a9cdbea6f8b1d3b8e08f08ca4a.
Each evidence outputHashes array contains only the catalogue hash; the six final non-manifest hashes resulting from candidate finalisation are not captured in the hash-generation evidence.
findings.impact: The evidence cannot establish a reproducible chronology or complete provenance chain from final R2 bytes to the manifest, despite the manifest hashes currently matching disk.
findings.remediation: Create a new append-only candidate using a non-circular content-set procedure: finalise and hash the substantive files, record concrete toolRuntimeVersions, timestamp, accountableOwner, disposition and all resulting hashes in evidence without self-hashing, then generate the canonical manifest last over the final six non-manifest bytes.

verdictRationale: Three open MAJOR findings leave the Phase 4 R2 plan non-executable, incompletely propagated and evidentially circular despite passing its contracts, schema validation and raw-byte hash checks.
residualGaps: Owner-supplied Azure region, resource, quota, capacity, deployment, embedding and recovery evidence remains unresolved and fail closed.
Provider-use, privacy, source-use and EU AI Act evidence remains unresolved and requires the accountable owner groups.
No benchmark, security-gate, route-parity, deployment, runtime or operating-effectiveness result is established.
requiredAction: Do not approve, promote, deploy or present this subject as complete.
